title: Smart Complaint Management System
description: A role-based complaint-management platform: citizens file complaints, staff move them through a Pending → In Progress → Resolved/Rejected lifecycle, and admins approve accounts and oversee the queue — across 15 REST endpoints guarded by JWT auth and bcrypt password hashing.

title: NoteFlow — 10Pearls Internship Project
description: Built during my MERN Stack Development internship at 10Pearls (10Shine Program): a full-stack notes application with JWT authentication, email verification, and full CRUD, plus data import/export and user profile management.

title: Shop.co E-Commerce Platform
description: A pixel-faithful rebuild of a community Figma template as a full MERN application — product filtering, search and pagination, reviews, promo-code validation, and order placement, backed by a MongoDB Atlas-seeded catalog.

title: Student Records App
description: A typed CRUD dashboard for managing student records with search and form validation — built in TypeScript to keep the data model honest end to end.

title: BuildVolt — PC-Build Recommendation SaaS
description: Our final year project, built with a 2-person team: a deterministic compatibility engine that infers CPU/RAM/PSU specs from catalog text and assembles budget-capped, safety-checked PC builds — plus a WordPress/WooCommerce plugin and a React + TypeScript store dashboard for catalog sync, CSV import, and analytics.

title: Multi-Page E-Commerce Website
description: A multi-page storefront built in React during my NAVTTC-affiliated full-stack training — catalog, product detail, and cart flows wired together with client-side routing.
